name: kie.ai Market API (image and video generation)
purpose: Optional remote generation behind one API key. The adapter implements the documented status envelope and polling; the create path and per-model inputs are NOT verified from a primary source. Never run without the user's key and approval.
capabilities: API-key authorization header, value taken from the KIE_API_KEY environment variable
GET /api/v1/jobs/recordInfo (documented): states waiting, queuing, generating, success, fail; resultJson string; credits reported afterwards

compatibility.notes: Verification level: partial (checked 2026-11-02). Contract-tested only against a local stub.

licensing.notes: Third-party paid service; terms and pricing are the provider's. No code copied.

security.notes: Sends the API key only to the API host (never to result CDNs). Requires outbound HTTPS and a paid account; makes billable calls.

approval_evidence: Local stub contract tests (tests/test-creative-intelligence.py TestKie). No live call has been made.
